_comment_display: 17-inch OLED-IB panel behind a DS90UH983/DS90UH988 link (one-to-one dual FPD-Link) and the ioc-deserializer MCU at 0x66, which runs the same REMOTE_DISP_OTS display_manager as the OTS-OLED. Both the sensor and the output talk to that one MCU. The OLED-IB TCON is a different part from the OTS-OLED's: 7-bit 0x62, brightness register 0x0837. display_manager v01.15 (sp6bins release 1.12) or later finds it at run time and reports its range in BRIGHT_MIN/BRIGHT_MAX; older firmware only knows the OTS TCON and NAKs every request here.
_comment_sensor: No OPT5001 is fitted on the first OLED-IB board (2026-10-21), so the daemon runs MANUAL-only and keeps retrying the sensor. lux_range values are RAW ADC CODES, as for the OTS-OLED, whose zone edges are kept below as a starting point until a sensor is fitted and measured.
_comment_zones: Zone edges copied from the OTS-OLED config (measured there 2026-09-10). Re-measure them on an OLED-IB with its sensor fitted before relying on AUTO mode; MANUAL brightness does not use them.
_comment_calibration: brightness_to_nits.sweep_table is a REFERENCE table swept on OLED-IB unit 1 (CS2.0 983HH rig) with an i1 Display Pro, full white; per-unit variation is normal. Re-run tools/als-dimmer-sweep.py on your panel and replace calibrations/oled_ib17.csv for accurate nits.
_comment_output: value_range is the OLED-IB TCON's own scale for register 0x0837: 11 (0x000B, 5 nits) to 2047 (0x07FF, 900 nits per the panel vendor), linear; measured full white 818.6 cd/m2 at 2047, 408.5 at 1029. The daemon sends percent; the ioc_tcon output maps it onto that range and checks it against BRIGHT_MIN/MAX read back from the IOC at start-up.
